summary: The guest's own comment sits at the top of the thread — thanking the hosts, thanking her fans, adding that the world is harsh so we should be kinder to each other, and then apologising for dropping her polite particles on camera and promising to do better. That self-correction sets the tone: most of the thread is about seeing a side of her the audience had not seen, and praising her outlook. A notable cluster refuses to take sides in the ongoing public comparison between her and another creator, arguing neither is wrong and that they follow both. Viewers pull out a line about not running away if you have done nothing wrong and connect it to the effect on her child. The closing segment made several commenters cry.
